sentence: 8 mm shaft: two k5 bearing seats, shoulder, keyway, ring groove, M8x1 thread, chamfers
design_notes: One revolve profile: M8x1 at 7.95 (6g major window), seat A 8 k5 (zone [8.001, 8.007]), shoulder 10, seat B and journal 8, 0.5 chamfers at both ends; a DIN 471 groove built by the groove feature at the start of seat A (z 8) and a DIN 6885-1 keyseat built by the keyway feature on the journal (+y, z 49, L 10).
